jobs_results.title: PHP/Wordpress Developer
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we're Fever

We're excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About The Team

Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world... Our family is composed of Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Atlanta, Secret Miami, Secret Toronto, Secret London, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta and more! Through our media outlets we inspire over 60 million people every week to discover the best experiences in their cities. https://secretmedianetwork.com/en/

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:
• Full immersion into our team, participating in team planning, grooming, and retrospectives.
• Familiarization with our tech stack, focusing on the Secret Media Network, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure.
• Multiple successful Pull Requests merged and deployed to production.
• Participation in Fever Original's experiences like Candlelight.

After 3 months at Fever:
• Proficiency in solving complex problems and taking charge of architecture design and implementation.
• Continual creation of production-grade PHP code capable of handling high levels of traffic, with a keen eye on functionality and product enhancement.
• Working closely with internal stakeholders to define and prioritize product development
• Collaboration in hackdays or hackathons with other teams, becoming well-acquainted with the entire engineering department.

In your 6th month at Fever:
• Assume responsibilities for various system components, analyzing user interactions and evolving the platform to meet their needs.
• Participation in launching large scale initiatives, from inception to production.
• Ideating and implementing initiatives to ensure the system performance and reliability
• Mentorship of fellow team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
• Engagement in team-building activities, fostering a cohesive engineering team spirit.

About You
• You're smart, get stuff done, have great energy, and thrive in a fast paced environment
• Deep knowledge on Wordpress and PHP
• You know how to create/modify WP plugins and themes
• You know how to handle several WP sites
• You are experienced handling DDBB such as MySQL
• You have experience working through cross-browser compatibility issues
• You are highly productive, self-starter and self-motivated
• You comply with defined coding standards
• You are proficient in business English

Additional Skills:
• Know how to create WP plugins and themes from scratch
• Systems knowledge (Cache, Load balancers, ...)
• Familiar with JIRA

Benefits & Perks
• Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
• Stock options.
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
• Home office friendly (based in Spain)
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
• Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
• English Lessons
• Gympass Membership
• Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.
• Salary range: 35 - 45 k

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: Senior Full Stack Developer PHP/Node.js
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de uno de los mayores distribuidores de productos FMCG de Europa?

¿Te apetece participar de un proyecto en continuo crecimiento, proyección internacional y formado por emprendedores de éxito?

Entonces, ¡sigue leyendo!

¿Qué buscamos?

Kovyx, distribuidor y fabricante europeo líder en el sector del jardín y del hogar en pleno proceso de transformación digital a todos los niveles de la empresa, busca incorporar un/a Senior Full Stack Developer PHP/Node.jspara liderar los proyectos de desarrollo a medida así como las diferentes integraciones con los sistemas empresariales de la compañía. Además, como team leader, te encargarás de planificar el trabajo y estimar los recursos necesarios para lograr los hitos establecidos de forma consensuada con la dirección general y los responsables de las áreas de negocio.

Puntos a favor del proyecto
• AUTONOMÍA: te incorporarás a una compañía en pleno proceso de transformación digital y expansión internacional. Guiado y... acompañado por los lideres de las áreas de negocio, tendrás plena autonomía en la toma de decisiones técnicas.
• GRATITUD: tus proyectos tendrán un gran impacto sobre el negocio lo cual llega a ser realmente gratificante si sientes pasión por tu trabajo y por el negocio.
• EMPRENDIMIENTO: entrarás en un momento de cambio de estrategia de la compañía respecto a la gestión de proyectos tecnológicos lo que te dará la oportunidad de aportar ideas que ayuden a optimizar procesos y recursos con el final de mejorar la rentabilidad del negocio.

Requisitos mínimos
• Pasión por el desarrollo, las nuevas tecnologías y los lenguajes de programación (al menos 10 años programando).
• +3 años programando con PHP/Node.js.
• Experiencia en Linux.
• Pedagogía: como team leader, tendrás la responsabilidad de acompañar a perfiles más junior en su crecimiento.
• Inglés alto escrito y hablado: estarás en contacto con partners internacionales.
• Pasión por el negocio, gran capacidad de autogestión, actitud de mejora y aprendizaje continuo. No somos agencia, somos creadores y vendedores de productos y experiencias.
• Ganas de afrontar problemas complejos y aportar soluciones en equipo.
• Disponibilidad para trabajar de forma 100% presencial en nuestras oficinas de Valdemoro. Siendo conscientes de los puntos débiles del trabajo presencial, creemos firmemente en la multitud de beneficios que genera, sobre todo en este momento de la compañía a nivel de negocio.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Interesante paquete retributivo (en función de la valía del candidato)
• Contrato indefinido
• Trabajo 100% presencial en oficinas de reciente creación en Valdemoro (Comunidad de Madrid), bien comunicadas, con parking, servicios de comida y gimnasio a disposición de los empleados en las propias instalaciones.
• Horario flexible.

Si crees que eres la persona que estamos buscando, mándanos hoy mismo tu CV. ¡Estamos deseando conocerte!

¿Quieres saber más sobre nosotros y nuestras marcas? Visita nuestra web: www.kovyx.com

Tipo de puesto: Jornada completa, Contrato indefinido

Beneficios:
• Comida en la empresa
• Gimnasio en la empresa
• Parking gratuito

Horario:
• De lunes a viernes

• Experiencia en Linux.
• Inglés alto escrito y hablado: estarás en contacto con partners internacionales.
• +3 años programando con PHP/Node.js.
• Pasión por el desarrollo, las nuevas tecnologías y los lenguajes de programación (al menos 10 años programando

jobs_results.title: PHP Engineer (Onsite)
jobs_results.description:
Are you looking for a the opportunity to join a small yet dynamic team building a SaaS solution, with a micro services architecture in PHP and Laravel? Are you a collaboration oriented professional who thrives in environments in which you are offered autonomy and the ability to contribute to the technical discussion? Are you open to working onsite, with a small team, supporting in not just the development of software but also in that of other team members as well? If you answered yes to all three then we're happy to connect and see if this role might fit what you're looking for.

As a senior Backend Engineer you will be leveraging your past experience with PHP, and Ideally Laravel as well, to help develop a travel tech system built on a microservices architecture. We're looking for people who are capable and competent enough to work both independently, as well as within a team, and who like to exercise ownership over their work.

Responsibilities
• Collaborate on all phases of the... development solutions, from conception to delivery.
• Build robust software with a focus on dynamic scalability.
• Focus on continuously improving the way we work by offering up innovative ideas for improvements aimed at impacting the scalability, performance and availability of our solutions.
• Support in the creation of tools or implementations of methodologies aimed at improving the way our team collaborates, with each other as well as with other teams and external parties.
• Proactively work on projects which will reduce bugs and improve production environments.

Must haves (Required)
• 5+ years of experience working in similar roles, with at least 3 years of PHP.
• Ample experience working with MySQL (or similar DB tool).
• Experience working in environments with structured code.
• Experienced working in Git enabled environments (Github, Bit Bucket, Gitlab, etc).
• Be able and willing to work onsite in Sant Cugat (4 days)

Nice to Haves (Bonus)
• Experience working with an MVC backend framework like; Laravel or Codeigniter.
• Experience or knowledge of LAMP stack

jobs_results.title: PHP DRUPAL Developer
jobs_results.description:
What is nazaríes intelligenia?

nazaríes intelligenia is a Spanish company focused on the development and service of software products. Its three lines of business help our clients to have a long term technological partner.

From the engineering division we improve and develop the software products used by thousands of people, from the customer success division we accompany the clients who must use these products, which includes the implementation of solutions, translation and technical support, and with all this knowledge we develop the third division, which consists of our own product on industry 4.0 to capture, store, work and visualize the data of any physical device, mainly focused on the industrial world and with special emphasis on the agro-industry.

Who are we looking for?

The product quality, the customer satisfaction and our team’s professionalism make the difference. With the aim to deliver our highly visible projects, we are looking for smart, collaborative, enthusiastic... and well-organized professionals who are willing to take an active part in a sustainable, long-term product venture with a start-up mindset. We are currently seeking a talented PHP Drupal Developer.

Role overview:

A PHP Drupal Developer is tasked with designing, developing, and maintaining websites and web applications using the Drupal content management system (CMS) and PHP programming language. Responsibilities include collaborating with stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, implementing custom functionality and modules using PHP and Drupal APIs, configuring and theming Drupal sites to meet design specifications, and ensuring the performance, security, and scalability of Drupal-based solutions. Additionally, PHP Drupal Developers may be involved in troubleshooting issues, optimizing site performance, and staying updated with Drupal and PHP best practices.

Skills and Qualifications:
• 4+ years' of experience in web development and software design.
• Proficiency in PHP: Strong understanding of PHP programming language, including object-oriented PHP concepts, syntax, and best practices.
• Drupal CMS Knowledge: In-depth understanding of Drupal CMS architecture, including core modules, theming system, and contributed modules. Experience with Drupal 7, Drupal 8, and preferably Drupal 9.
• Front-end Technologies: Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery for implementing and customizing Drupal themes and front-end components.
• Third-party Integration: Experience integrating Drupal with third-party APIs, services, and systems for features like payment gateways, social media integration, and content syndication.
• Strong Problem-solving Skills: Ability to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, and implement effective solutions in Drupal projects
• English (B1 minimun).

Key responsibilities:
• Perform a mix of maintenance, enhancements, and new development as required.
• Work in a data analyst role and with business intelligence applications.
• Document features, technical specifications & infrastructure responsibilities.
• Work cross-functionally to convert business needs into technical specifications.
• Continuous learning: Staying updated with the latest trends, best practices, and advancements in PHP development.

What we offer:

✔A professional and multicultural working environment with people from all over the world.

✔An organized structure, product of years of experience in the industry, which allows all agents to benefit from our expertise.

✔All the required software, tools and database.

✔A fixed contract focused on a long-term relationship.

✔Health Insurance

✔24 days of vacation + December 24th and 31th.

✔Restaurant tickets.

✔Online training financed from 50% to 100% (Languages, AWS, Oracle, Azure, Languages)

🍷 Last but not least, team drinks a few times a month

jobs_results.title: PHP Senior Developer
jobs_results.description:
En Acertto Talent Linkers estamos especializados en la búsqueda y selección de talento.

Con oficinas en Madrid y Valencia, ofrecemos servicio de Headhunting para toda Europa y norte de África.

Nuestra experiencia, método y conocimiento profundo facilita el contacto entre empresas y profesionales especializados del sector.

En esta ocasión, estamos buscando un/una PHP Senior Developer para una importante empresa en el sector retail con tiendas en España y Portugal.

Tu misión principal será participar en los proyectos de desarrollo y mantenimiento de los sistemas informáticos en el entorno web. Contarás con ambiente dinámico en el que tendrás la oportunidad de aportar a la evolución del equipo.

Requisitos mínimos
• Estudios superiores de informática, software o relacionados.
• Conocimientos avanzados de PHP, JavaScript, HTML y CSS
• Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL), Sistemas de control de versiones (Git) y Frameworks como Symfony, Laravel o Angular.
•... Conocimientos acerca de los principios SOLID y Clean Code.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación con todo tipo de personal.
• Experiencia de 4 años en un puesto similar.

Valorable
• Experiencia con integración ERP, CRM y PIM.
• Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos: PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM…etc.

Se Ofrece
• Contrato indefinido.
• Posición estable y con posibilidad de desarrollo profesional.
• Horario Flexible y modalidad híbrida.
• Salario competitivo

• Estudios superiores de informática, software o relacionados.

• Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL), Sistemas de control de versiones (Git) y Frameworks como Symfony, Laravel o Angular.

jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem zuverlässigen und talentierten Senior PHP Backend Developer, der gemeinsam mit uns Innovationen schafft.

Aufgaben
• Sei ein Teil des Teams: Ein reines Remote-Team, das die Stärke hat, zusammenzuarbeiten und gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen.
• Individuelle Entwicklung: Innovative Lösungen schaffen, mit denen wir die Bedürfnisse und Probleme unserer Kunden befriedigen.
• Reibungslose Prozesse: Nahtlose Anbindung von Drittsystemen wie ERP, PIM oder CRM an Softwaresysteme, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf für unsere Projekte zu schaffen.
• Implementierung von Anforderungen: Setze konzeptionierte Anforderungen in hochwertigen Code um und erwecke komplexe Projektideen zum Leben.
• Überprüfung und Qualitätssicherung: Überprüfe und bewerten die Arbeit des Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass jedes Projekt den höchsten Qualitätsstandards entspricht.

Qualifikation
• Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der PHP-Entwicklung
• Mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit... einem der folgenden Systeme: Shopware, Shopify, Sylius oder Spryker
• Du kannst Probleme analysieren und Lösungen definieren
• Reine Remote-Arbeit ist für dich kein Problem
• Du arbeitest selbständig und hast einen hohen Anspruch an die Qualität deiner eigenen Arbeit
• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch

Optional:
• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Englisch

Benefits
• Remote Only: Alle unsere Strukturen und Abläufe sind so gestaltet, dass du arbeiten kannst, wo immer du willst. Ob von zu Hause, einem Café oder sogar vom Büro in Palma aus.
• Asynchrone Arbeitsweise: Wir arbeiten zeitlich asynchron und du hast, abgesehen von deinen wenigen festen Terminen, keine Vorgaben, wann du arbeitest.
• Ausbildungsbudget: Wir haben ein festes Budget mit Tagen, über das du jedes Jahr frei verfügen kannst. Wenn dein Training mehr Budget und mehr Tage benötigt, sprechen wir einfach darüber und finden eine Lösung.
• Ausrüstung: Wir kümmern uns in Absprache mit dir um deine Ausrüstung zu Hause, damit du dich wohlfühlst und ohne Probleme arbeiten kannst.Weitere Vorteile: Fitnessstudio-Beitrag, Teilnahme an Messen und Konferenzen, Firmenevents auf Mallorca und vieles mehr
